subject: general
question: Who among the following became the first para-athlete to be conferred with the Padma Bhushan award, in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devendra Jhajharia**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devendra Jhajharia ** became the first para-athlete to be conferred with the **Padma Bhushan**, India's third-highest civilian award, in 2022.
 
• Devendra Jhajharia is a javelin thrower who competes in the F46 category for athletes with upper limb impairments.
 
• He has won **two gold medals** at the Paralympic Games:
 
 
• **2004 Athens Paralympics** – Set a new world record in the F46 javelin throw category.
 
• **2016 Rio Paralympics** – Broke his own world record with a throw of 63.97 meters.
 
 
 
• Won a **silver medal** at the **2020 Tokyo Paralympics**, demonstrating his consistent excellence over nearly two decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Suhas L Yathiraj****​**

 
 
• Suhas Yathiraj became the first IAS officer to win a Paralympic medal.

 
 
• Yathiraj is an officer in the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), having achieved success in one of the toughest examinations in the country at the very first attempt. 
 
 
 
• Yathiraj graduated in computer engineering from the National Institute of Technology, Surathkal, Karnataka in 2004.
 
 
• The bright Yathiraj went on to clear the Civil Services examination in 2006 and then began his career as an IAS officer in 2007.
 
 
 
• It was only in 2015-16 that he turned into a professional para-badminton player and has since then been managing his duty as the District Magistrate of Gautam Buddha Nagar and his training as a sportsperson to good effect.
 
 
 
• Pramod Bhagat 
 
 
• ​He is an **Indian professional Para-badminton player from Odisha.**
 
• He **won a gold medal at the 2020 Summer Paralympics** in Men's singles SL3.
 
 
 
• **Manish Narwal****​**
 
 
• Manish Narwal (born 17 October 2001) is an Indian Para Pistol Shooter.
 
• He ranks fourth in the world in Men's 10m Air Pistol SH1 according to the World Shooting Para Sports Rankings.
 
• Manish is also supported by GoSports Foundation through the Para Champions Programme.
 
• Shooting has inspired competition, and in several countries, rifle clubs started to form in the 19th century.
